title: Copy-site semantics preservation
statement: Let $x$ be a Boolean input, $B$ a natural-number register bound, $k$ a copy site, $p$ a rational number, and $\sigma$ a register state. Suppose every register of $\sigma$ is at most $B$, and the value in the destination register selected by $k$ is at most the value in its source register. If the program has probabilistic semantics $p$ from the entry state associated with $k$, with the destination register replaced by the source register’s value, then it has probabilistic semantics $p$ from the copy instruction for $k$ with the original register state.

The destination register value is at most the source register value
